name: Tibialis Raise Against Wall

instructions.description: Stand with the back against a wall and feet slightly forward.
Keep the heels down and lift the toes toward the shins.
Lower the toes slowly without rocking the body.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Tibialis Raise Against Wall — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Tibialis Raise Against Wall — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Stand closer to the wall to reduce difficulty.
